recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man with long, dark wavy hair wearing a bright blue textured turtleneck, set against a soft-focus outdoor background of pine needles and warm, hazy sunlight. The composition is anchored by a right-aligned, thin-stroke geometric typeface.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the cool blue of the sweater and the warm yellow-green of the background
Balance between the subject on the left and the large-scale typography on the right
Harmony between the organic textures of the hair/trees and the rigid geometry of the font
coreInvariants: Soft-focus lens effect with a slight hazy glow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, positioned from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes are the primary anchor, with the bright blue sweater acting as a secondary color anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the subject's face to the text block in the upper right, then down the texture of the sweater.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right quadrant serves as active negative space for the typography, filled with blurred natural elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue (sweater) providing a vibrant focal point.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden yellow and olive green (background) providing warmth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep brown/bronze (typography) echoing the hair and shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject's clothing against a desaturated, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital colors; stick to earthy 70s tones.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing but generous line height
characterSpecificRedesigns: Leg of 'R' is straight and diagonal
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all display elements to maintain 70s minimalist elegance.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the quintessential 70s geometric look and thin stroke.
Provides the necessary geometric circularity and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s style portrait of a man with long wavy dark hair, smiling, wearing a bright blue ribbed turtleneck sweater. Background is a soft-focus, hazy outdoor scene with pine needles and warm golden sunlight. Use a vintage film aesthetic with slight grain and soft edges.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply uppercase geometric sans-serif text in a thin weight, right-aligned in the upper right corner. Use a dark bronze color for the text.

verificationChecks: Is the sweater a vibrant blue with visible ribbing?
Is the lighting warm and hazy?
Is the font weight extremely thin?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's head.
Verify the '70s film grain' texture is present but subtle.
Check that the blue of the sweater is the most saturated element.
Confirm the font is a geometric sans-serif.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a [Subject Description] in a [Saturated Color] [Textured Clothing] with a [Soft Focus Nature Background] and [Right-Aligned Thin Geometric Typography].
